transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I came in because most days I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling in my chest. It’s like… I don’t know, the old Ruben, the guy who could talk to anybody and enjoy his day, he just feels gone.
Have you been enjoying the things you used to enjoy?

No, not really. I used to look forward to things like bowling, working in the garden, taking my wife to gallery shows, going dancing. Now I just kind of sit there and make excuses not to go. None of it feels worth the effort anymore.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful event or major change in your life?

Yeah… I’d say it started around eight months ago. That’s when the new regional manager came in and really started coming down on me, taking away accounts I’d had for years. It’s been going on since then.
When you're away from work, do you still feel this same heaviness?

Yeah. Even when I’m not at work, it’s still there. I wake up with that heavy, empty feeling in my chest most days, like I’m not really myself anymore. The part of me that used to talk to people easily and enjoy the day… it just feels gone.
For at least two weeks, have you felt down or depressed most of the day nearly every day?
Yes. Most days I wake up feeling really down, with this heavy, hollow feeling in my chest. It’s like the old me—Ruben, who could talk to anybody and actually enjoy the day—is just gone.
If the situation at work were resolved, do you think these feelings would go away?

I don’t know that it would just go away. Work is a big part of it, sure, but this feeling is there most days when I wake up… that heavy, hollow feeling in my chest. It feels like the old me, the Ruben who could talk to anybody and enjoy his day, is just not there anymore.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?

Yes. At night I’ll just lie there, staring at the ceiling, replaying work stuff over and over. And when I finally do sleep, I’m up around three or four in the morning already feeling worn out and dreading the day.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

Yes… I have. I’ve had thoughts that maybe my wife and kids would be better off if I just didn’t wake up. I don’t like saying that, but it’s been coming into my head, and it scares me. I don’t trust myself the way I used to.
Have you made a specific plan to end your life?

I haven’t made a specific plan, no. It’s more that I keep thinking my wife and kids might be better off if I just didn’t wake up. And the fact that those thoughts are there… it scares me. I don’t feel like I can trust myself the way I used to.
Have you been feeling worthless or blaming yourself a lot?

Yes. I keep telling myself I’m useless now. Like all those years I worked, took care of clients, provided for my family… it feels like none of it counts anymore because I can’t even handle this job. I blame myself for that a lot.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?
I’m not really sure. I mean… I haven’t been paying close attention to that, I guess. I know I’m not feeling like myself, but with concentrating specifically, I don’t know.
Before this started eight months ago, had you ever gone through another period in your life when you felt depressed like this for at least two weeks?
I’m not sure. I mean, I’ve had hard times before, like anyone, but I don’t know if I’d say it was like this or lasted that long. I haven’t really thought about it that way before.
Have you noticed your appetite has decreased?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really been paying attention to my appetite. I don’t think I can say for sure either way.
Before these past eight months, did you ever have another period when you felt depressed like this nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I really don’t know. I’ve had rough stretches before, but I can’t say there was another time where I felt like this nearly every day for two weeks or more.
Have you been feeling tired or low on energy nearly every day?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I’ve felt worn down at times, but I haven’t been keeping track of whether it’s nearly every day.
Before these past eight months, was there ever another time in your life when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I’m not sure. I’ve had some bad periods in my life, but I can’t say for sure that it was most of the day nearly every day for two weeks like that.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about many different things?
I’m not sure I’d call it excessive. I do worry about things, but I haven’t really noticed whether it’s about a lot of different things or more than normal.
Do you generally think poorly of yourself?
Yeah… I do. I keep thinking I’m useless now. Like all those years I spent taking care of clients and providing for my family don’t even count, because I can’t even seem to handle this job anymore.
Before these past eight months, was there ever a time in your life when you clearly felt depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?

Before this? I don’t know that I can clearly say that. What I can say is lately, most days I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling in my chest… like the old me, the guy who could talk to anybody and enjoy his day, is just gone.
Have you been feeling low on energy nearly every day?
I’m not really sure. I know I feel worn down a lot, but I haven’t paid close attention to whether it’s nearly every day.
